english.note: Use this when giving something back to its owner or returning something that was lost or taken.
Use this when paying money back or returning money that was borrowed or owed.

examples.english: I’ll restore your book to you tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 waan4 faan1 bun2 syu1 bei2 nei5

examples.english: I’ll replace the money I owe you next month when I get paid.
examples.traditional: 我下個月出糧就還返啲錢畀你。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 ceot1 loeng4 zau6 waan4 faan1 di1 cin2 bei2 nei5
